view: The governance story has moved from overhang to event: Huang resigned as CEO, President and director effective immediately (8-K, no reason given), three days after the board probe opened and amid a DOJ inquiry and congressional calls for his exit. I recommend the chair treat TB2 as FIRED (pause all buying) pending owner approval, re-assess after Huang's congressional testimony and the 2026-11-17 print. TB1 not fired, TB3 not fired, but both odds are higher than in my first submission.

probabilities.defs: 2w ±5%, quarters ±10%, vs price_at_call 164.33 (2026-11-12 intraday, revision 2). next_2_weeks: up > +5% (close > 172.55), down < -5% (close < 156.11), range between; measured at the 2026-11-25 close (2026-11-26 is Thanksgiving, market closed). this_quarter: last close of Q4 2026 (2026-12-31); next_quarter: last close of Q1 2027 (2027-03-31); up > +10% (> 180.76), down < -10% (< 147.90), range between. up + range + down = 100.

evidence.point: SEC 8-K (filed 2026-11-12): Board accepted Huang's resignation as President, CEO and director on 2026-11-11, effective immediately; CFO Kress interim CEO while remaining CFO; external and internal search; Harvey C. Jones appointed first-ever Chair. The 8-K gives no reason. An immediate exit that also removes him from the board, with no succession plan (Fortune 2026-11-09) and no stated reason, is the pattern of a forced or pressured departure, not a planned transition.

Timing: resignation came three days after the board opened its Wachtell Lipton investigation, amid the reported DOJ inquiry into Megaspeed (~240,000 chips / $7.5bn alleged) and Senator Cramer's call for his resignation. This sequence is the core argument that TB2 has fired.

Counter-evidence for TB2: no public finding that Nvidia knowingly violated export controls and no charges against Huang reported; the board probe is framed as whether Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation (victim framing); Huang agreed to testify to Congress before Thanksgiving, which is cooperation, not a legal compulsion reported in the slice.

Market reaction: open 151.005, low 148.80, recovery to ~164 on ~499M shares; AMD and Broadcom up to ~5% and US indices reversed higher. The market treated the exit as a large but partly-resolved shock: the 'when does the shoe drop' uncertainty is gone, replaced by succession and testimony uncertainty.

Outside view 2w (n=258): up 33 / range 45 / down 22. Moved to 33 / 27 / 40 (range -18, down +18). Inside the window: earnings 2026-11-17 with an interim CEO, and Huang's congressional testimony before 2026-11-26. Two binary events plus ATR 6.0% daily make a close inside ±5% on 2026-11-25 much less likely than usual; testimony risk skews it down.

Outside view to 2026-12-31 (n=253): up 39 / range 43 / down 18. Moved to 32 / 34 / 34 (down +16). The -10% line (147.90) is just below today's low (148.80), so a single adverse DOJ/Congress headline would be enough; CEO search news is unlikely to land by year-end.

Outside view to 2027-03-31 (n=247): up 50 / range 31 / down 19. Moved to 40 / 28 / 32 (up -10, down +13). Losing a founder-CEO is a lasting change to the key-person thesis, and the TB1/TB3 paths stay open into Q1 2027; partly offset by intact fundamentals and the chance that a credible permanent CEO is named.

Two-week change is now -19.7%; after 2w drops <= -15% the next 13w was up in 4 of 4 (median +32.1%), but n=4, overlapping windows, and none involved a CEO exit under investigation. Weak evidence; it only stops me from pushing next_quarter further down.

Recovery of 10.4% from the low on volume 3.8x the 60d average looks like absorption, but the bar is open and the hammer shape is unconfirmed until the close. Price-pattern reading belongs to technical; counted once and not weighted heavily here.

Week: NVDA -15.45% vs SOX +7.99%, AMD +30.2%, AVGO +17.46%: still idiosyncratic. Peers rising on the news suggests the market sees share/mindshare risk, not an AI-demand break (no TB4 evidence in my slice).

Last-quarter revenue YoY +105.9%, fwd P/E on next FY 17.85, 58 of 73 Buy, lowest target 180: fundamentals are intact on these numbers. Kress as CFO-turned-interim-CEO gives continuity on the numbers for the 2026-11-17 print, but not on strategy or customer relationships.
The coordinator referred to a thesis_break_status field; it is not in my slice (not in slice). My TB calls below are my own judgment from news_governance.
Options positioning not in my slice / unavailable this run: I cannot see how much of the testimony and earnings tail is already hedged, which caps my confidence in the 2w down skew.

what_would_change_my_mind: TB2 NOT fired (unpause): the board or the investigation report states Huang resigned for personal reasons unrelated to the probe/DOJ, and the board investigation concludes he was a target, not a participant, before 2026-12-31.
TB2 more clearly fired: testimony before 2026-11-26, a DOJ filing, or a company disclosure in the 2026-11-17 release/10-Q links the resignation to the Megaspeed matter or a legal exposure.
TB1 fires: any DOJ charge, settlement or company admission that Nvidia (not only Megaspeed) violated export controls; a legal-proceedings disclosure in the 10-Q would raise my TB1 odds sharply.

TB3 fires: an export-restriction bill or Commerce rule enacted/published before 2027-03-31 that materially cuts Nvidia's addressable market; a markup scheduled right after the testimony would raise my odds.
More bullish: a credible permanent CEO named, uneventful testimony, and a daily close back above 179.92; more bearish: a daily close below 148.80 after the testimony or the print.
notes_for_chair: RECOMMENDATION: treat TB2 as FIRED (pause all buying) pending owner approval. Strongest argument FOR: the CEO left effective immediately, also left the board, with no stated reason and no succession plan, three days after a board investigation opened and while a DOJ inquiry and a senator's resignation call were live; that is departure under legal/regulatory pressure in substance. Strongest argument AGAINST: the rule says 'legal or regulatory pressure' and there is no charge, no finding and no stated link; the board probe is framed as Huang possibly being a victim of a foreign intelligence operation, and he is testifying voluntarily, so this could be a reputational/personal exit. Why I lean FIRED: the rule exists to pause buying while key-person and legal risk is unresolved; a wrong 'fired' call costs a short pause, a wrong 'not fired' call means buying into the testimony and a possible TB1. Proposed re-check: after the testimony (before 2026-11-26) and after the 2026-11-17 print.

Re-estimated TB odds (judgment, not slice numbers): TB1 next 2w ~4% (was ~3%), within 2 quarters ~20% (was ~15%): the exit raises the chance the probe finds something, but DOJ timelines are long and the inquiry is about Megaspeed's routing. TB3 next 2w ~4% (was ~3%), within 2 quarters ~25% (was ~20%): a CEO exit plus televised testimony gives the Capitol Hill restriction push momentum, but enactment is slow. TB4 outside my lane.

What changed vs first submission: price_at_call 165.785 -> 164.33 and new buckets (2w measured 2026-11-25); TB2 moved from 'not fired, ~4%/~10%' to 'recommend fired'; view moved from Wait/Hold to buying paused under TB2; 2w from 33/30/37 to 33/27/40; this quarter from 34/36/30 to 32/34/34; next quarter from 43/30/27 to 40/28/32; confidence 45 -> 50 because the key fact in my lane is now a filed 8-K, not headlines.

Before vs after earnings (2026-11-17): before, my view is driven by governance and is down-skewed. After, update on (a) any legal-proceedings or risk-factor language on DOJ/BIS/Megaspeed, (b) whether Kress or the new Chair addresses the resignation reason and the CEO search timeline. Beat/miss size belongs to fundamentals. The testimony (before 2026-11-26) is a second binary event in the same 2w window.

Noise vs signal next 2 weeks: noise = senators' statements, China denials, target cuts, commentary. Signal = testimony content (especially anything on what Nvidia knew about Megaspeed), DOJ filings, board statements on resignation reason, 10-Q legal disclosures, key executive departures following Huang.

Cross-domain: thesis_break_status referenced by the coordinator is not in my slice. Options positioning still unavailable (sentiment/red team). Technical should confirm whether today's hammer survives the close. Peers (AMD, AVGO) rallying on the news is a share-shift question for relative_strength/fundamentals.

Pre-mortem: if badly wrong in 3 months, the likely reason is that the market treated the exit as the end of the story and re-rated a fwd P/E 17.85 stock fast (too bearish, and TB2 pause cost entries near the low); or that testimony/DOJ revealed company knowledge and TB1 fired (then my TB1 odds were too low).

Stance: buying paused if the owner approves TB2 as fired; otherwise Tactical Avoid New Entry until after the testimony and the print, Strategic Hold under review (founder-CEO loss changes the key-person thesis). Reduce not available (no recorded position). No orders suggested; ladder changes only with owner approval.
